Removable, UL certified, stated available anywhere in the US (single source)

reasons.text: Bosch CX mid-drive, 85Nm, suited to hills
Removable battery stated to be available anywhere in the US

You want the cheapest new bike with hydraulic brakes

nextSteps: Confirm Trek battery price and stock with a dealer

contradictions.assessment: Source 4 says $1,399 (early 2026); source 8 (2024 blog) says $1,699. Source 4 is newer but less reliable; verify current price.
Source 4 table says mechanical but its text says hydraulic; source 7 says hydraulic. Source 7 more reliable.
